derivation: perhaps from the base of G3313 (μέρος) (through the idea of adjustment of parts);

occurrences.text: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
